choices.label: Travel north and recover Nester's dagger
choices.text: You travel to the ankheg country north of the city. Among the remains in the nest you recover Nester's dagger, then return to Baldur's Gate. Your journal still requires you to deliver it to Quinn.

choices.label: Leave the northern journey for later
choices.text: The dagger remains outside the city. You return to your other affairs.

choices.label: Travel to Beregost and steal Algernon's cloak (Agility 16)
choices.text: In Beregost you lift Algernon's cloak without taking his life. You return with the cloak; Pheirkas still awaits your answer.

choices.label: Travel to Beregost and kill Algernon for the cloak
choices.text: You kill Algernon and take his cloak. News of the murder harms your standing. Pheirkas has yet to receive the cloak.

choices.label: Leave Algernon alone for now
choices.text: You postpone the Beregost journey. Pheirkas has received nothing.

choices.label: Travel to the lighthouse and kill Sil
choices.text: You take the coastal road to the lighthouse and fight Sil and the sirines. On returning to Baldur's Gate you can report their deaths to Cordyr. The city pays no reward until that conversation.

choices.label: Spare Sil and return without fulfilling the contract
choices.text: You leave Sil alive. Cordyr's request remains unfulfilled.

adaptationRules.outsideExcursions: Explicit named text resolutions replace only authorized outside-city scenes. They consume city time, preserve refusal and pending outcomes, grant actual unique quest items once, and grant no bundled outside combat XP. They are not native outside-map combat evidence.
adaptationRules.services: Native healing, poison/disease effects, curse removal and actual-actor revival are adapted status rules; source spell formulas remain unimplemented. Donation exact reputation table unresolved.
adaptationRules.inventory: Raw charge words and source flags remain separate from normalized stack counts. Native equipment slots are filled only where source items fit existing gear classes.
adaptationRules.recruitment: Alora uses three staged talks plus explicit lookout agreement during classic21:30-03:30 window. EE AR0130 script TimeGT20/TimeLT4 is unresolved versus that classic window. Skie requires actual living Eldoth within8native tiles on same level; original Detect line-of-sight semantics remain pending.
adaptationRules.canonicalRelocation: ALDETH/TAMOKO/NARLEN retain one serialized actor and actual inventory across source-backed scenes. Local named quest/choice stages replace audited original movement globals; raw source conditions remain in scene metadata. Old duplicate scene actors are parked without merging or granting their possessions.

narlenTimer.conversion: Source event timer units map to20bounded native mapturns; original wall-clock/game-time parity remains pending.

adaptationRules.startingHistory: Explicit finish or first exploration outside start radius1, NPC conversation, accepted quest, trade, theft or recruitment freezes earlier history. Unchosen Aldeth/Tenya/Eldoth entries are explicitly unspecified, never inferred successful or hostile. Entry equipment/gold/XP snapshot is not overwritten.

storePricing.conversion: For source stackables, item base price times normalized stack quantity precedes source markup/floor; purchase minimum1. Nonstackable charge words never become quantity. Source store capability bits, purchased categories and fenced-goods restrictions apply.
storePricing.sourceGap: Supporting implementation inference, not original-byte proof. Exact reputation/reaction modifiers, charge-ratio and depreciation formulas remain pending.

donations.sourceGap: Supporting EE base only; MONEY_CHURCH source units and exact original donation formula need reconciliation. Native rule charges BASE_CHURCH threshold once for one local reputation/standing point; no gain at18..20.
